title: Double-exposure fashion portrait
original_prompt: A cinematic double-exposure fashion portrait featuring a woman with the uploaded face used 100% as reference, wearing stylish metallic aviator sunglasses. The composition blends a large semi-transparent close-up profile of her face on the left with her full-body figure on the right. Minimalist neutral studio setting. Warm desaturated sepia and charcoal palette, soft golden-orange light-leak flare. Professional 85mm lens, high-contrast soft cinematic lighting, natural skin texture, luxury fashion-editorial aesthetic.
author: @Anaya_Ai12
why_it_is_good: Combines reference-image technique with a strong compositional device.
